processes.action_idea: A daily job compares metered and allocated volumes by meter against active Sitara deal tickets and flags flow with no deal, an expired term or a strangers gas assignment. It routes each exception to the deal owner on record with the meter, dates and volumes already filled in. The deal owner still decides whether to extend, create a deal or sign off a write-off to unaccounted-for gas.
processes.description: Logistics and volume management find gas flowing at a meter with no deal, an expired deal or volumes on the strangers gas contract, and chase the deal owner to create or extend a Sitara ticket or approve a write-off to unaccounted-for gas.
processes.name: Meter flow with missing or expired deal resolution

processes.action_idea: After each allocation run, a comparison of POPS/MOPS meter volumes, UA4 results, pipeline statements and counterparty actuals lists every meter whose numbers disagree beyond a tolerance, with the prior month for context. Analysts receive one exception list instead of piecemeal emails. Volume management still decides which number is right and whether to reallocate.
processes.description: Staff research meter allocation exceptions, UA4 and unaccounted-for differences, bad feeds and volume mismatches between pipeline, counterparty and internal systems, then move volumes or correct allocations.
processes.name: Meter volume and allocation variance resolution

processes.action_idea: When invoices or counterparty statements arrive, a match against the Sitara deal price and volume flags each line that differs and opens a case with the deal number, both figures and the trader. The trader still confirms which price is correct and approves any deal change or invoice dispute.
processes.description: Settlements, accounting or counterparties report a price or volume mismatch between an invoice, a payment and the booked deal, and the desk verifies, disputes or corrects the deal so the invoice can be finaled.
processes.name: Deal price and invoice discrepancy resolution

processes.action_idea: A structured request template for requesters covering deal number, counterparty, meter, dates, volume, price, book and reason for the change. The desk uses a matching confirmation reply that returns the new or changed deal number, so requests do not need clarification rounds.
processes.description: Traders, schedulers and accounting ask the desk to create, amend, rate-change, path, split or clean up Sitara and Tagg deal tickets and confirm the deal number back.
processes.name: Sitara deal ticket entry and correction requests

processes.action_idea: When a termination or book-move list arrives, a script looks up every live deal for the listed counterparties or deal numbers and produces the move file for the target book, plus a before-and-after check. The book admin reviews exceptions and runs the move; credit still decides which counterparties are terminated.
processes.description: Risk, credit or middle office send lists of deals or terminated counterparties to move or flip between trading books, including bankruptcy books, and the book admin moves them and confirms before books are calculated.
processes.name: Deal and counterparty book transfers

processes.action_idea: When the credit report email arrives, its counterparty list is parsed and matched against booked deals, producing a rebook worklist per book admin instead of a forwarded attachment. The book admin still performs and confirms each rebook or reserve.
processes.description: The periodic credit report listing counterparties to rebook, pending credit or do-not-confirm is forwarded to book admins, who rebook deals or take credit reserves.
processes.name: Credit report distribution and rebooking

processes.action_idea: A standard request form for book setup and access listing book name, region, trader, portfolio code, systems and approver, used by desk staff when they ask. Book admins reply with a completion checklist so nothing is chased twice.
processes.description: Requests to create or map books, curves, portfolio codes and EOL products in Tagg/Sitara, and to grant or change user IDs, logins and access for desk staff.
processes.name: Trading book setup and system access requests

processes.action_idea: Incoming nomination emails and attachments are parsed on arrival into a nomination feed that shows the change against the current nomination by meter and day. Schedulers still approve the change and confirm with the pipeline.
processes.description: Daily, monthly and revised gas nominations from counterparties such as Calpine, plus volume and election changes, are received, keyed into scheduling systems and confirmed.
processes.name: Counterparty nomination intake and changes

processes.action_idea: Operational notices are parsed on arrival into a feed of affected meters, dates and expected volume impact, matched to the nominations on those meters. Schedulers still decide how to renominate or notify producers.
processes.description: Gas control, field operations and on-call staff report shut-ins, cuts, maintenance, leaks and weekend activity that schedulers must read and act on.
processes.name: Pipeline operations, shut-in and outage notice relay

processes.action_idea: A monthly job compares pipeline imbalance statements with internal scheduled and measured volumes per OBA and produces a reconciliation sheet with differences highlighted. The commercial or scheduling contact still agrees the balance and approves payback or cash-out.
processes.description: Scheduled versus measured volumes and imbalances on pipelines and interconnect OBAs are reconciled with counterparties, with support sent and paybacks or cash-outs approved.
processes.name: Pipeline and OBA imbalance reconciliation

processes.action_idea: An amendment request template capturing contract number, shipper, requested change, effective date and approval, used by the account director when forwarding to contract administration. It removes back-and-forth on missing details.
processes.description: Shippers ask to change Transwestern contract receipts, MDQ, names or capacity, and the account director approves and forwards the request to contract administration to amend.
processes.name: Transportation contract amendment approvals

processes.action_idea: A scheduled job each week pulls delivery and capacity data and posted Gas Daily prices and generates the report email in the existing format. The analyst only reviews the numbers and adds commentary before sending.
processes.description: Each week California deliveries, capacity utilization and Gas Daily prices are compiled and emailed to the Transwestern commercial team.
processes.name: Weekly California capacity report

processes.action_idea: CAISO notice emails are parsed on arrival into a categorized feed (derate, settlement, procedure, market design) with the effective hours, posted for the real-time desk. Traders still decide what action a notice requires.
processes.description: CAISO notices on derates, settlements, procedures and market changes are read and forwarded to the real-time desk so it can adjust.
processes.name: CAISO market notice relay

processes.action_idea: A maintained real-time desk procedures checklist covering Enpower deal entry, cut handling, tags and time changes, used by shift traders at the start of each shift. The desk lead updates one document instead of re-sending instructions.
processes.description: The real-time desk lead repeatedly emails procedures and rules on deal entry in Enpower, tags, cuts, checkouts and scheduling that shift traders must follow.
processes.name: Real-time desk standing procedures

processes.action_idea: A fixed handoff template listing position by hour and hub, book, deals to key, open issues and problems from the last shift, used by the desk lead and shift operators at each handover.
processes.description: The desk lead tells the shift the day's long and short positions, deals to enter and books to use, and shift operators report missed schedules and problems back.
processes.name: Real-time position and shift handoff

processes.action_idea: A daily comparison of Enpower deals and congestion awards against CAPS and settlement data lists variances by hour and book. Settlements and the real-time desk still decide on the correcting entry or PMA.
processes.description: The real-time desk reconciles Enpower deals, congestion revenue, annuities and prior-month adjustments against CAPS, inc sheets and settlement flashes, and chases corrections before the P&L flash.
processes.name: Real-time congestion and deal settlement reconciliation

processes.action_idea: A nightly and month-end checklist for book admins covering post ID officialization, DPR review, imbalance sign-off, flash completion and Schedule C notifications, with the deadline for each step.
processes.description: Producing, reviewing and approving daily P&L and position reports, officializing post IDs, and answering P&L flash, Schedule C and book list questions.
processes.name: Daily P&L, position and post ID sign-off

processes.action_idea: A request template capturing the period, counterparties, deal numbers, report type and due date, plus standard reply wording for the desk analyst who pulls the data.
processes.description: Auditors, management and other groups request deal tickets, P&L support, origination detail, curve validation explanations or counterparty deal lists, which the desk pulls and sends.
processes.name: Deal data and audit support requests

processes.action_idea: A monthly survey checklist with the due date, the fields each group must fill and a reminder reply, used by the coordinator who collects responses.
processes.description: Finance repeatedly asks operations groups for activity and hours surveys, budget questionnaires and cost-center allocation checks by a deadline.
processes.name: Cost center surveys and allocation requests
